content:
Hi everyone!

I'm Yansı Evre Yüksel, a Mathematics BSc graduate from Boğaziçi University in Istanbul. I've been working in the game industry as a developer since graduating (the past 4 years), but I've decided to make a change and get back into math/academia, so I'll be starting my Mathematics Master's this semester at Freie Universität Berlin.

Since I'm a programmer, formalizing maths with Lean has piqued my interest. I'm currently learning Lean. I've completed the Natural Number Game and I'm currently working through Mathematics in Lean, using it as an opportunity to refresh my math knowledge as well.

Nice to meet you all!

Welcome! I was in Berlin before moving to Bonn, so more Lean interest there still exites me. There are quite a few people doing Lean in Berlin now - make sure to say hi in #Geographic locality > Berlin, DE also (or meet people the old-school, face-to-face way)!

@Michael Rothgang Ooh nice, thanks for letting me know

@Yaël Dillies Yes, I've been here since graduating.

Then I guess Yael will tell you about the Polyhedra in Lean workshop next, right? (I was there last week and found it very friendly. If you're not into convex geometry or discrete math, it might not be your cup of tea - but otherwise, I can highly recommend it.)
I'd be happy to drop by later today if that's okay!
I must note that there is a public solution of the platonic-classification lean-eval task here
@Yaël Dillies Im here but the door is locked
